abstract: This study examines the factors influencing producer adoption of cover cropping and no‐till farming, two key carbon sequestration practices, within the context of voluntary carbon credit programmes (CCPs) in Kansas. Using a mixed‐methods survey that combines discrete choice experiments with farm‐level data from 370 producers, we estimate random‐parameter latent class models to assess preferences over contract design, payment levels and agri‐environmental constraints. Findings reveal substantial misalignments between current CCP structures and producer needs: nearly half of respondents consistently rejected all contract offers, while those most willing to enrol were often already using the promoted practices, raising concerns about the additionality of these initiatives. Key barriers include long contract durations, insufficient payments and agri‐environmental limitations such as drought and wheat‐based rotations. These results highlight the need for more flexible, regionally tailored carbon programmes and provide actionable insights for policymakers seeking to enhance the adoption and climate impact of agricultural carbon sequestration initiatives.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在堪萨斯州自愿碳信用计划（CCPs）背景下，影响生产者采纳覆盖作物种植和免耕耕作这两种关键碳封存实践的因素。通过结合离散选择实验与来自370位生产者的农场层面数据的混合方法调查，我们估计了随机参数潜在类别模型，以评估对合同设计、支付水平及农业环境约束的偏好。研究发现，当前CCP结构与生产者需求之间存在显著错位：近半数受访者一贯拒绝所有合同提议，而最愿意参与的生产者往往已在采用所推广的实践，这引发了对这些项目额外性的担忧。主要障碍包括合同期限过长、支付不足以及干旱和以小麦为基础的轮作等农业环境限制。这些结果凸显了对更灵活、区域定制化碳项目的需求，并为政策制定者提供了可操作的见解，以促进农业碳封存倡议的采纳及其气候影响。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Misalignment in Carbon Credit Programmes: Insights From Producer Preferences for Cover Crop and No‐Till Contracts
title_zh: 碳信用项目中的错位：来自生产者对覆盖作物与免耕合同偏好的启示

abstract: We document how childcare costs and the location of extended family influence the labor supply and mobility of US women. Women return to their home locations immediately before fertility events, suggesting that informal childcare needs may motivate home migration. Women who live near their parents have lower child earnings penalties. We then build a model of labor supply and migration to assess the impacts of childcare subsidies. Childcare subsidies increase earnings and mobility among US women and ignoring migration can understate the welfare benefits of these policies, especially for college-educated women and those whose parents' locations have poor amenities.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了育儿成本及大家庭地理位置如何影响美国女性的劳动供给与流动性。女性在生育事件前夕返回原籍地，这表明非正式育儿需求可能促使返乡迁移。居住于父母附近的女性，其子女带来的收入惩罚较低。随后，我们构建了一个劳动供给与迁移模型，以评估育儿补贴的影响。育儿补贴提升了美国女性的收入与流动性，而忽视迁移因素可能会低估这些政策的福利效益，尤其是对受过大学教育的女性及父母所在地环境条件较差的女性而言。
title: To Grandmother's House We Go: Informal Childcare and Female Labor Mobility
title_zh: 去奶奶家：非正式儿童照护与女性劳动力流动

abstract: We document that 11 percent of recent U.S. high school graduates did not apply for federal student aid due to difficulty in applying, mistaken beliefs, or lack of awareness. Not applying due to such application frictions negatively predicts college enrollment after controlling for other attributes. We represent application frictions as heterogeneous filing costs in a general equilibrium life cycle model of college enrollment. We find that eliminating these frictions generates modest gains on average because less than half of those affected would ultimately utilize aid. However, welfare gains are large for the affected few with high skill and poor parents.
abstract_zh: 我们记录到，近期美国高中毕业生中有11%因申请困难、误解或缺乏了解而未申请联邦学生资助。在控制其他特征后，因这类申请摩擦而未申请的行为对大学入学率有负面预测作用。我们将申请摩擦表示为大学入学一般均衡生命周期模型中的异质性申报成本。研究发现，消除这些摩擦平均而言仅带来适度收益，因为受影响者中不到一半最终会利用资助。然而，对于少数技能高且父母贫困的受影响个体，福利收益显著。
title: College Financial Aid Application Frictions

title: Sourcing with Demand Updates

abstract: Using website cookie information from U.S. firms’ websites, I measure consumer data collected through cookies and examine how such data affect firms’ accounting information environments. Cookies provide granular and real-time consumer data to firms’ internal information environments and may improve the quality of internal information that managers rely on for external reporting. I find that firms with more cookies issue management sales forecasts more frequently and devote a larger share of disclosures in 10-K filings to customer, marketing, and product topics. The effects are stronger when cookie-collected data are more relevant or larger in volume and when firms have better data analytic technology. However, proprietary costs and data privacy protection mechanisms attenuate these effects. Using the California Consumer Privacy Act as a quasi-natural experiment, I provide causal evidence linking cookie-collected data to voluntary disclosure. Overall, the study highlights the role of firm-collected consumer data in shaping accounting information environments.
abstract_zh: 利用美国企业网站中的Cookie信息，我衡量了通过Cookie收集的消费者数据，并考察了这些数据如何影响企业的会计信息环境。Cookie为企业内部信息环境提供了细粒度且实时的消费者数据，可能提升管理者依赖以进行外部报告的内部信息质量。研究发现，拥有更多Cookie的企业更频繁地发布管理层销售预测，并在10-K文件中将更大比例的披露内容分配给客户、营销和产品相关主题。当Cookie收集的数据更具相关性或规模更大，以及企业拥有更好的数据分析技术时，这些效应更为显著。然而，专有成本和数据隐私保护机制会削弱这些效应。利用《加州消费者隐私法案》作为准自然实验，我提供了将Cookie收集数据与自愿性披露联系起来的因果证据。总体而言，本研究强调了企业收集的消费者数据在塑造会计信息环境中的作用。
source_issue: Journal of Accounting and Economics, Volume 82, Issue 1
title: Website cookies and voluntary disclosure

abstract: Reward schemes may affect not only agents' effort but also their incentives to gather information in order to reduce the riskiness of the productive activity. In a laboratory experiment using a novel task, we find that the relationship between incentives and evidence gathering depends critically on the availability of information about peers' strategies and outcomes. When no peer information is available, competitive rewards are associated with more evidence gathering than noncompetitive rewards. In contrast, when decision-makers know what or how their peers are doing, competitive rewards schemes are associated with less active evidence gathering than noncompetitive schemes. The nature of the feedback—whether subjects receive information about peers' strategies, outcomes, or both—also affects subjects' incentives to engage in evidence gathering. Specifically, only combined feedback about peers' strategies and performance—from which subjects may assess the overall relationship between evidence gathering, riskiness, and success—is associated with less evidence gathering when rewards are based on relative performance; we find no similar effect for noncompetitive rewards.
abstract_zh: 奖励方案不仅可能影响代理人的努力程度，还可能影响他们收集信息以降低生产活动风险的动机。在一项采用新颖任务的实验室实验中，我们发现激励与证据收集之间的关系关键取决于关于同伴策略和结果信息的可获得性。当没有同伴信息时，竞争性奖励比非竞争性奖励与更多的证据收集相关联。相反，当决策者了解同伴在做什么或如何做时，竞争性奖励方案与非竞争性方案相比，与较少的主动证据收集相关联。反馈的性质——受试者是否收到关于同伴策略、结果或两者的信息——也影响受试者参与证据收集的动机。具体而言，只有结合同伴策略和表现的反馈——受试者据此可评估证据收集、风险性与成功之间的整体关系——才与基于相对表现的奖励下较少的证据收集相关联；对于非竞争性奖励，我们未发现类似效应。
title: Evidence Gathering Under Competitive and Noncompetitive Rewards
title_zh: 竞争与非竞争性奖励下的证据收集

abstract: This paper explores within‐country variations in food price dynamics and food poverty estimates by employing local market price data and national consumer price index (CPI) data. Our results show that national CPI data may be useful for approximating national trends but they fail to detect and identify spatial variations in local trends, which have relevant welfare implications. Indeed, sourcing cereal prices from local markets, instead of national CPI statistics, leads to classification divergences in 9% of food poverty predictions, with a substantial variation in estimation errors across countries. Our findings thus underscore the need for the systematic collection of local price data to ensure effective policymaking, such as adjusting social transfers to better reflect local differences and optimizing the allocation of social funds.
abstract_zh: 本文通过运用地方市场价格数据与全国居民消费价格指数（CPI）数据，探讨了食品价格动态及食品贫困估计的国内差异。研究结果显示，全国CPI数据虽有助于近似反映全国趋势，但无法捕捉和识别地方趋势中的空间差异，而这些差异对福利具有重要影响。实际上，若从地方市场获取谷物价格而非依赖全国CPI统计，会导致9%的食品贫困预测出现分类偏差，且各国间的估计误差差异显著。因此，我们的研究结果强调了系统收集地方价格数据的必要性，以确保政策制定的有效性，例如调整社会转移支付以更好地反映地方差异，并优化社会资金的分配。
title: Lost in aggregation? On the importance of local food price data for food poverty estimates
title_zh: 迷失在加总中？论本地食品价格数据对食品贫困估算的重要性

abstract: ER (KSS) program, a 6-month, school-based intervention evaluated through a clustered randomized control trial in rural Appalachia to reduce sugar-sweetened beverage (SSB) consumption among 7th-grade students. KSS includes a classroom-based student component (KSS-S) grounded in the Theory of Planned Behavior and health literacy, and a caregiver component (KSS-C) delivered through two-way text messaging to modify household beverage practices. Using structural equation modeling grounded in a Stackelberg household production framework, we estimate how behavioral strategies, health literacy, and caregiver-child decision-making jointly shape students' SSB intake. Stronger behavioral intentions are associated with a 5.30 oz/day reduction (p<0.01), and the caregiver decision index (capturing household rules, availability, and role modeling) corresponds to a 16.41 oz/day reduction. KSS-S reduces intake by 6.42 oz/day (p<0.05), largely through a direct pathway (6.23 oz/day, p<0.05). KSS-C reduces intake by 4.22 oz/day, primarily through caregiver-mediated effects (3.36 oz/day). Combined, both components reduced students' SSB consumption by 10.64 oz/day (36% from baseline) (p<0.01). We use the estimated structural parameters to simulate hypothetical SSB tax scenarios, finding that KSS achieves reductions comparable to those generated by modest tax rates. This suggests that school-based behavioral interventions like KSS can function as complementary or alternative policy tools. By identifying causal mechanisms and enabling counterfactual policy simulations within a unified framework, the structural approach provides richer policy insights than average treatment effects alone.
abstract_zh: ER（KSS）项目是一项为期6个月的校本干预，通过集群随机对照试验在阿巴拉契亚农村地区评估，旨在减少七年级学生的含糖饮料（SSB）消费。KSS包括基于计划行为理论和健康素养的课堂学生组成部分（KSS-S），以及通过双向短信传递以改变家庭饮料实践的家庭照护者组成部分（KSS-C）。基于Stackelberg家庭生产框架，运用结构方程模型，我们估计了行为策略、健康素养及照护者-儿童决策如何共同影响学生的SSB摄入量。更强的行为意图与每日减少5.30盎司相关（p<0.01），而照护者决策指数（涵盖家庭规则、可得性和榜样作用）对应每日减少16.41盎司。KSS-S使摄入量每日减少6.42盎司（p<0.05），主要通过直接路径实现（每日减少6.23盎司，p<0.05）。KSS-C使摄入量每日减少4.22盎司，主要通过照护者中介效应（每日减少3.36盎司）。两者结合，将学生的SSB消费每日减少10.64盎司（较基线下降36%）（p<0.01）。我们利用估计的结构参数模拟假设的SSB税收情景，发现KSS实现的减少效果与适度税率产生的效果相当。这表明像KSS这样的校本行为干预可以作为互补或替代的政策工具。通过在统一框架内识别因果机制并进行反事实政策模拟，结构方法比仅依赖平均处理效应提供了更丰富的政策洞见。
title: How does the Kids SIPsmartER program impact the sugar‐sweetened beverage intake of students: An investigation beyond total treatment effect in randomized controlled trial
title_zh: Kids SIPsmartER项目如何影响学生的含糖饮料摄入：随机对照试验中总处理效应之外的探究

abstract: Variable correlations pose significant challenges for various LASSO-type shrinkage methods in big-data modeling. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for a correlation-robust shrinkage estimator, enhancing both the theoretical and practical aspects of high-dimensional estimation. We break down the penalty term into a “shrinkage” term and a “grouping” term, illustrating its distinctive properties in clustering highly correlated variables. We establish the (non-)asymptotic properties of this estimator under relaxed assumptions regarding mixing conditions and heavier-tailed distributions. Furthermore, we demonstrate the consistency of model selection under mild conditions. Additionally, we propose a debiased version of the estimator, proving its asymptotic normality. Simulated data indicate that the debiased estimator surpasses traditional benchmarks. In an empirical application, we use this debiased estimator to identify key Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) factors that account for inflation levels. Our findings imply that news-based EPU factors are essential in explaining CPI dynamics.
abstract_zh: 变量相关性在大数据建模中对各类LASSO型收缩方法构成了显著挑战。本文提出了一个针对相关性稳健收缩估计量的综合框架，增强了高维估计的理论与实践层面。我们将惩罚项分解为“收缩”项与“分组”项，展示了其在聚类高度相关变量方面的独特性质。在关于混合条件及重尾分布的宽松假设下，我们确立了该估计量的（非）渐近性质。此外，我们证明了在温和条件下模型选择的一致性。同时，我们提出了一种去偏版本的估计量，并证明了其渐近正态性。模拟数据表明，该去偏估计量优于传统基准。在实证应用中，我们利用此去偏估计量识别了影响通胀水平的关键经济政策不确定性（EPU）因素。我们的研究结果表明，基于新闻的EPU因素在解释CPI动态中至关重要。
title: A sorted penalty estimator: Inference for a correlation-robust shrinkage method
title_zh: 排序惩罚估计量：一种相关稳健收缩方法的推断

abstract: In cooperative games with communication networks, it is typically assumed that two players can communicate whenever there is a connecting path between them, regardless of its length. We relax this assumption by introducing a new concept, k -boundedness, which sets an upper bound on the length of admissible communication paths. Building on this idea, we define a restriction operator for feasible coalitions in communication games, which leads to a new solution concept extending the Myerson value. Our first main contribution is an axiomatic characterization of this solution within the class of games with communication networks. The characterization combines the classical Fairness axiom with new axioms capturing the effect of k -boundedness constraints on cooperative possibilities. We then investigate the feasible coalition structures that arise under arbitrary k -boundedness constraints, which we term feasible communication structures. Within this alternative framework, we provide another axiomatic characterization of our solution concept.
abstract_zh: 在具有通信网络的合作博弈中，通常假设只要两个玩家之间存在连接路径，无论其长度如何，他们就能进行通信。我们通过引入一个新概念——k-有界性，放宽了这一假设，该概念为可允许的通信路径长度设定了上限。基于此思想，我们为通信博弈中的可行联盟定义了一个限制算子，从而引出一个扩展了Myerson值的新解概念。我们的第一个主要贡献是在具有通信网络的博弈类别中，对该解进行了公理化刻画。该刻画将经典的公平性公理与捕捉k-有界性约束对合作可能性影响的新公理相结合。随后，我们研究了在任意k-有界性约束下产生的可行联盟结构，称之为可行通信结构。在此替代框架内，我们为我们的解概念提供了另一种公理化刻画。
title: k-boundedness, feasible communication structures, and the Myerson value
title_zh: k-有界性、可行沟通结构与Myerson值

abstract: • In economics journals, the share of theoretical work declined between 2000 and 2024, while empirical research, especially in development, labor, and public economics, expanded and received substantially higher citation counts. • Network analysis of economics journals reveals persistent concentrations of scholarly influence. • In the economics discipline, a small set of elite U.S. universities occupies central positions in citation and co-authorship networks. • Despite changes in research topics and methods, the structure of scholarly knowledge production in economics remains hierarchical, suggesting that intellectual innovation occurs within a stable institutional core. This paper examines patterns in knowledge production within the top-five economics journals from 2000 to 2024. Drawing on the full set of published articles and associated bibliometric details, citations, co-authorship links, and institutional affiliations, I document notable shifts in the orientation of research. The share of theoretical work has declined, while empirical fields, particularly development, labor, and public economics, have expanded. Network analysis shows that although the substantive questions and analytical approaches in top-five journals are changing, a small group of U.S. universities continues to account for a disproportionate share of highly cited work and occupies central positions in citation networks, a core that at the same time facilitates communication and exchange across fields.
abstract_zh: 在2000年至2024年间，经济学期刊中理论研究的比重有所下降，而实证研究，尤其是发展经济学、劳动经济学和公共经济学领域，则不断扩展并获得了显著更高的引用次数。对经济学期刊的网络分析揭示了学术影响力的持续集中现象。在经济学学科内，少数美国精英大学在引用和合著网络中占据核心位置。尽管研究主题和方法发生了变化，学术知识生产的结构在经济学中仍保持层级性，这表明知识创新发生在一个稳定的制度核心之内。本文考察了2000年至2024年间五大顶级经济学期刊中的知识生产模式。基于全部已发表文章及其相关的文献计量信息、引用、合著关系和机构归属，我记录了研究方向上的显著转变。理论工作的比例有所下降，而实证领域，特别是发展经济学、劳动经济学和公共经济学，则有所扩张。网络分析显示，尽管五大顶级期刊的实质性问题和分析方法正在变化，少数美国大学群体继续占据高被引工作的不成比例份额，并在引用网络中处于中心位置，这一核心同时促进了跨领域的交流与交换。
source_issue: Journal of Comparative Economics, Volume 54, Issue 2
title: Network analysis of “top-five” economics journals
title_zh: 五大”经济学期刊的网络分析
